callees.name: _strip_comments_from_source
callees.pre_condition: text is a string containing source code. lang_key is a string key identifying a supported source language whose comment syntax rules are known.
callees.post_condition: Returns the content of text with all comments removed according to the comment syntax rules of the language identified by lang_key. Source code tokens present in the original text appear in the returned string at the same relative positions; only comment-character ranges are elided.

callees.name: _get_call_regex
callees.pre_condition: lang_key is a string key identifying a supported source language.
callees.post_condition: Returns a compiled regex pattern whose iteration over source text yields matches where the first capture group contains a bare-name function-call identifier recognized as a call expression in the language identified by lang_key.
